notes.title: Football Game - new patch
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've uploaded a small patch that fixes a small bug late in the game if events are undertaken in a specific order. 

Old save game files should not be broken by this update.

Many thanks,
Shaun
[b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b]

notes.title: Football Game - soundtrack update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for your continued support of Football Game :)

Just a quick update - I've updated the Soundtrack DLC to also include high quality FLAC versions of the songs. So the soundtrack download now includes both MP3 and FLAC versions of the songs.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/804030/Football_Game__Official_Soundtrack/

The physical cassette release of the soundtrack is now also on a crazy special over at [url=https://ramberrecords.com/releases/ram012-football-game-ost-jupiter-c]Ramber Records - you can get the cassette for £1![/url] Verrrry limited copies left. The cassette also comes with a soundtrack download code for Bandcamp, and a Steam key for the game!

Many thanks for your support, 

Shaun
[i][b]Cloak and Dagger Games[/b][/i]
